in_sanskrit.name: इलियास
in_sanskrit.meaning: God of Gods, Vishnu or Krishna
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Iliyas is derived from Sanskrit 'इलिय' (Iliy) which means 'God' and 'आस' (As) which means 'Lord of'. The full name Iliyas thus signifies 'Lord of Gods' or 'God of Gods'. In Hinduism, this name is associated with Vishnu or Krishna.

in_hindi.name: इलियास
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Iliyas in Hindi is transliterated as 'इलियास' (Iliyas). The meaning of the name in Hindi is 'ईश्वर' (Ishvar), which means 'God' or 'Lord'.

in_tamil.name: ஈலியாஸ்
